title: Crispy Rice Paper Dumplings (Vegan)
description: Finely chopped vegetables and tofu folded into rice paper parcels and pan-crisped on sesame seeds, with a soy and sweet chilli dip.

yield.note: Generous; the creator ate all five as one meal

time.label: Quick; no time given in the source

source.name: Firsttakehadrian (Instagram)
source.note: Hype or Hoax, Episode 268, rated 9.36/10 (Worth the Hype). Original inspiration: @broccoli_mum.

confidence.note: Amounts and method from the creator's caption. Not yet cooked. Mushroom, cabbage, rice vinegar and sesame amounts are loose in the source, and cooking times are not given.

nutrition.note: As stated by the creator (50 cals and 5g protein per dumpling).

items.note: Half a block; type and block size not stated
1–2 US tbsp in the source; a splash goes in the filling and the rest in the dip

steps.title: Chop
steps.text: Blitz the mushrooms, zucchini ({{zucchini}}), carrot ({{carrot}}), cabbage and tofu ({{tofu}}) in a food processor until finely chopped.

steps.title: Cook filling
steps.text: Cook the mixture in a non-stick pan with a splash of the soy sauce and the garlic powder ({{garlic-powder}}) for a few minutes until the vegetables soften.

steps.title: Wrap
steps.text: Dip a rice paper sheet in water until soft, add a generous portion of filling to the centre and fold into a sealed parcel. Repeat to make 5 ({{rice-paper}}).

steps.title: Crisp
steps.text: Scatter the sesame seeds into a non-stick pan and cook the dumplings on top until golden and crisp on both sides.

steps.title: Dip
steps.text: Mix the remaining soy sauce with the rice vinegar and sweet chilli sauce ({{sweet-chilli}}) and serve with the dumplings.

notes.title: Thermomix
notes.text: The Thermomix could do the chopping in place of a food processor. The source gives no settings for this.
